question_set.question: Use calculate_correlation with method equal to pearson and use identify_clusters with n_clusters equal to 3, method equal to kmeans in order to know What patterns can you observe in the relationship between delivery time and order value, and how does service rating relate to these factors?

answer.value: There is virtually no correlation (0.007) between delivery time and order value, indicating these are independent factors. Most orders are delivered within 20-40 minutes and have values between 500-1000 INR. Service ratings are evenly distributed across all delivery times and order values, with average ratings around 3.24 regardless of the delivery speed or order amount. This suggests that customer satisfaction is not strongly influenced by these operational metrics.

key_insights: No correlation between delivery time and order value
Service ratings independent of delivery time and value
